thread:
ben: Alert from PagerDuty — 5xx rate jumped 18% across hosted inference gateway in us-west-2. Seeing a lot of 502/504 from router layer. :rotating_light:
ops-bot: [ALERT] gateway-5xx-rate > 15% for service=redwood-api/gateway-us-west-2 span=5m
sre-oncall: I'm on it, tagging @deepti and @jordan for recent rollout context. :eyes:
deepti: I rolled out a small change earlier — `session_pin_preference` toggle to enable route-affinity optimization for some tenants. Canary target 5% but I see traffic slices were incorrectly set.
jordan: can you paste the rollout command?
deepti: `./deployctl rollout --flag session_pin_preference=true --scope canary --weight 5 --env prod --region us-west-2`
alice: monitoring shows error class 'kvcache-miss-timeout' spiking concurrently with 502s. Latency p95 for token fetch increased from 40ms -> 240ms.
support-sam: support is getting multiple customer tickets complaining about failed requests and timeouts, some billing retries triggered. Customers: acct-112, acct-998 reporting errors since ~1725004300.
billing-bot: [INFO] Duplicate charge attempts detected for acct-998 — retry workflow hit 5xx and retried. Potential billing noise.
ben: timeline: deploy at 1725004200, alerts start 1725004300, tickets come in 1725004400. Looks correlated.
sre-oncall: deepti — is the flag global or per-route?
deepti: Supposed to be per-tenant via selector `tenant_id in {112,998}` but I accidentally omitted `--selector` in the rollout job. So it landed globally in the canary cluster slice. :grimacing:
jordan: that explains it. The affinity change increases KV cache churn; many backends were not prepared and timeouts cascade to 502/504.
alice: quick repro snippet (local):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.io/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-instruct-1","input":"test"}' --max-time 3
# returns 502 after 2.8s with header X-gw-reason: kvcache-timeout
```
ben: Can we hotfix? Option A: rollback flag globally. Option B: pin traffic away from canary slice and roll forward properly with selector.
sre-oncall: Rolling flag back is fastest. deepti — can you run `featurectl rollback session_pin_preference --env prod --region us-west-2`? I'll prepare traffic shields.
deepti: Running rollback now. `featurectl rollback session_pin_preference --env prod --region us-west-2`
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] rollback job started by deepti at 1725004580
jordan: while rollback runs, set the shedder to more aggressive drop for slow upstreams to prevent retries from amplifying. `shedderctl set slo 1s` for routing layer.
alice: I've opened a temporary route pin to route 100% of new requests to stable pool in us-west-2. Doing a soft cutover.
support-sam: Notifying affected customers: acct-112 acct-998 — providing ETA ~15m, asking for error logs (X-Request-Id).
billing-bot: [ACTION] Pausing automatic retry billing workflow for acct-998 to avoid duplicate charges.
ops-bot: [DEPLOY] rollback completed at 1725004725. Feature state: `session_pin_preference=false` across prod/us-west-2.
sre-oncall: Observability — 5xx rate dropping, p95 token fetch back to ~50ms. Still seeing some lingering 504s from long-tail requests.
deepti: will follow up with proper scoped rollout and add unit test to ensure `--selector` is required for tenant-scoped flags. Adding runbook note to avoid global misapply.
jordan: next steps: 1) support to reply to customers with root cause and rollback note, 2) engineering postmortem to identify why canary weight didn't prevent global application, 3) add preflight validation to deploy pipeline.
benn: typo — tagging @alice not @ben. :sweat_smile:
alice: already drafting customer messages and filling support tickets with timeline and mitigation steps.
sre-oncall: closing incident channel in 30m if metrics continue to stabilize. Good catch everyone. :thumbsup:
